gradeTiers.title: Early Learning & Kindergarten (Pre-K to K)
gradeTiers.description: Sensory readiness, counting 1-20, phonemic sounds, and basic shapes.

gradeTiers.title: Elementary School (1st - 5th Grade)
gradeTiers.description: Place values, arithmetic, reading comprehension, silent E, and ecosystem science.

gradeTiers.title: Middle School (6th - 8th Grade)
gradeTiers.description: Ratios, pre-algebra, argumentative writing, cells, and civics.

gradeTiers.title: High School (9th - 12th Grade)
gradeTiers.description: Algebra, financial math, astrophysics, rhetoric, and economics.
